sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受nytimes.com/subscribe上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的雷切尔·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the Trump administration completed its demolition of the East Wing of the White
sentences.zh: 周四，特朗普政府完成了对白宫东翼的拆除工作，

sentences.en: House to make way for a new presidential ballroom.
sentences.zh: 以便为新的总统宴会厅腾出空间。

sentences.en: Nobody's actually seen anything quite like it.
sentences.zh: 实际上没人见过这样的场面。

sentences.en: I think it'll be one of the great ballrooms anywhere in the world.
sentences.zh: 我认为它将成为世界上最伟大的宴会厅之一。

sentences.en: And like so much of the administration's agenda, the decision to turn the 123-year-old annex into a pile of rubble has attracted a mixture of reactions.
sentences.zh: 和政府的许多议程一样，将这座拥有123年历史的附属建筑夷为平地的决定引发了各种反应。

sentences.en: That is not your building.
sentences.zh: 那不是你的建筑。

sentences.en: Condemnations.
sentences.zh: 谴责。

sentences.en: He is tearing down the house.
sentences.zh: 他正在拆除这座房子。

sentences.en: He is tearing down the people's house.
sentences.zh: 他正在拆除人民的房子。

sentences.en: Praise.
sentences.zh: 赞美。

sentences.en: I saw it today.
sentences.zh: 我今天看到了。

sentences.en: It looks fantastic.
sentences.zh: 看起来棒极了。

sentences.en: I'm delighted he's doing it.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴他这么做。

sentences.en: And I love seeing these liberals melt down.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢看这些自由派崩溃的样子。

sentences.en: And ethics concerns.
sentences.zh: 以及道德方面的担忧。

sentences.en: Trump can apparently hit up his donors to bankroll the demolition of the literal edifice of our democratic government.
sentences.zh: 特朗普显然可以向他的捐赠者筹款，为拆除我们民主政府的实体建筑提供资金。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Luke Broadwater explains who's paying for Donald Trump's latest construction project and why the demolition is striking a nerve.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事卢克·布罗德沃特将解释是谁在为唐纳德·特朗普最新的建设项目买单，以及为什么这次拆除触动了敏感神经。

sentences.en: It's Friday, October 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月24日，星期五。

sentences.en: Luke, when this news broke, I have to confess, I did not know what to make of it.
sentences.zh: 卢克，当这个消息传出时，我必须承认，我不知道该怎么看。

sentences.en: Like, I did not understand how big of a deal it was to demolish the East Wing or to build a giant ballroom.
sentences.zh: 比如，我没意识到拆除东翼或建造一个巨大的宴会厅是一件多么重大的事情。

sentences.en: And I have felt a little bit surprised by the reaction.
sentences.zh: 而且我对各方的反应感到有些惊讶。

sentences.en: I'm curious if you did also.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇你是否也一样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, this story in some way sort of came out of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这个故事在某种程度上是突然冒出来的。

sentences.en: I mean, we knew that Donald Trump wanted to build a big, impressive ballroom.
sentences.zh: 我们知道唐纳德·特朗普想建造一个宏伟、令人印象深刻的宴会厅。

sentences.en: And he had sort of waved around pictures of what it might look like.
sentences.zh: 他曾展示过它可能的样子。

sentences.en: And we knew at some point that was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道迟早会发生。

sentences.en: But what he had said was that the existing structure wouldn't be touched, that it was going to
sentences.zh: 但他当时说的是现有的结构不会被触动，这只是一个扩建项目，

sentences.en: be an addition that would just bump out the East Wing and build in addition to what was already there.
sentences.zh: 会在东翼的基础上向外延伸，在原有建筑上增加一部分。

sentences.en: And so when excavators started crashing into the East Wing and tearing it apart, that really struck everybody by surprise.
sentences.zh: 所以当挖掘机开始撞击东翼并将其拆毁时，这确实让所有人都感到震惊。

sentences.en: I mean, here was essentially a whole wing that's been built onto the White House over time that
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这基本上是白宫多年来扩建的一整个侧翼，

sentences.en: was being completely ripped apart with no public notice without anybody knowing about it.
sentences.zh: 在没有任何公开通知、没人知情的情况下被彻底拆除了。

sentences.en: And historians started speaking out against it.
sentences.zh: 历史学家们开始公开反对。

sentences.en: People who work in the sort of historic architecture space were crying foul.
sentences.zh: 那些从事历史建筑领域工作的人们纷纷表示不满。

sentences.en: And obviously, Democrats were up in arMs.
sentences.zh: 显然，民主党人对此感到愤怒。

sentences.en: You know, Elizabeth Warren's calling it illegal.
sentences.zh: 你知道，伊丽莎白·沃伦称这是非法的。

sentences.en: At the same time, we're hearing from Republicans who are saying, all this outcry is much ado about nothing.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我们也听到共和党人说，所有的抗议都是小题大做。

sentences.en: You know, every construction project at some point doesn't look very good, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，任何建设项目在某个阶段看起来都不会太好看，对吧？

sentences.en: While you're tearing things up before they're built.
sentences.zh: 在你拆除旧建筑还没建好新建筑的时候。

sentences.en: And just trust the process and wait till the end.
sentences.zh: 相信这个过程，等到最后再说。

sentences.en: President Trump is the master builder.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统是建筑大师。

sentences.en: You Democrats are just looking for anything to criticize.
sentences.zh: 你们民主党人只是在找借口批评。

sentences.en: We were hearing a lot of back and forth.
sentences.zh: 我们听到了很多争论。

sentences.en: And so we wanted to find out what the facts are.
sentences.zh: 所以我们想弄清楚事实真相。

sentences.en: Were they taking down the entire East Wing?
sentences.zh: 他们是要拆掉整个东翼吗？

sentences.en: Were they going to leave a little bit of it up?
sentences.zh: 他们会保留一部分吗？

sentences.en: Like, what was the plan here?
sentences.zh: 这里的计划到底是什么？

sentences.en: And why hadn't anybody been told about it?
sentences.zh: 为什么没人被告知这件事？

sentences.en: And so I went down to the White House to try to get some answers from the people behind this.
sentences.zh: 所以我去了白宫，试图从幕后人员那里得到一些答案。

sentences.en: OK, so speaking of the facts, what is this project exactly?
sentences.zh: 好的，说到事实，这个项目到底是什么？

sentences.en: Where did this come from?
sentences.zh: 它从何而来？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So President Trump, he always is looking around the White House looking for things to improve.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统总是环顾白宫，寻找可以改进的地方。

sentences.en: He's in his second term.
sentences.zh: 他现在是第二个任期。

sentences.en: He's looking to leave a legacy.
sentences.zh: 他想留下自己的政治遗产。

sentences.en: He has already renovated what used to be the Rose Garden and turned that into what they're calling the Rose Garden Club.
sentences.zh: 他已经翻新了以前的玫瑰园，并将其改造成他们所说的“玫瑰园俱乐部”。

sentences.en: He's built a patio out there.
sentences.zh: 他在外面建了一个露台。

sentences.en: He's hosting dinners and DJing and hosting parties there.
sentences.zh: 他在那里举办晚宴、当DJ并举办派对。

sentences.en: He's DJing?
sentences.zh: 他当DJ？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's like one of his favorite things to do.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是他最喜欢做的事情之一。

sentences.en: He has a playliSt.
sentences.zh: 他有一个播放列表。

sentences.en: It's full of like show tunes and oldies and, you know, Gloria.
sentences.zh: 里面全是百老汇音乐、老歌，还有，你知道，格洛丽亚的歌。

sentences.en: He loves Gloria and he loves to entertain and have people over.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢格洛丽亚，也喜欢招待客人。

sentences.en: And honestly, he's trying to make the White House as much like Mar-a-Lago as possible.
sentences.zh: 老实说，他正试图让白宫尽可能像海湖庄园。

sentences.en: He's trying to leave his stamp on the White House.
sentences.zh: 他试图在白宫留下自己的印记。

sentences.en: If you look at what's been done in the Oval Office, there's been so much gold added.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看椭圆形办公室做了什么，就会发现增加了太多的金色。

sentences.en: And this is the latest step of that.
sentences.zh: 而这是其中的最新一步。

sentences.en: He has felt that the East Room, where they often have dinners, is not big enough.
sentences.zh: 他觉得他们经常举办晚宴的东厅不够大。

sentences.en: It holds about 200 people, 250 people perhaps.
sentences.zh: 它大约能容纳200到250人。

sentences.en: And he wants to quadruple that, essentially.
sentences.zh: 他想把这个容量扩大四倍。

sentences.en: He wants to have a place where you could have about 1,000 people have a really grand, big dinner.
sentences.zh: 他想有一个地方可以容纳大约1000人，举办一场非常盛大的晚宴。

sentences.en: And he has started looking at the East Wing and he thinks the East Wing is too small and unimpressive.
sentences.zh: 他开始关注东翼，觉得东翼太小且不够气派。

sentences.en: In his view, he doesn't like the idea of having to put up a tent if there's going to be a big party and seat people outdoors.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，他不希望在举办大型派对时还要搭帐篷把人安排在户外。

sentences.en: He wants a grand ballroom and he thinks this is the best place on the White House campus, to put it.
sentences.zh: 他想要一个宏伟的宴会厅，并认为这是白宫园区内放置它的最佳地点。

sentences.en: And so he's proposed initially building onto the East Wing to create this grand ballroom, which would be essentially about twice as big as the White House residence.
sentences.zh: 所以他最初提议在东翼扩建以创造这个宏伟的宴会厅，这基本上是白宫住宅面积的两倍。

sentences.en: So it's going to be a huge addition.
sentences.zh: 所以这将是一个巨大的扩建工程。

sentences.en: But what we didn't know is that along the way, as they started to evaluate this plan for the ballroom,
sentences.zh: 但我们不知道的是，在评估宴会厅计划的过程中，

sentences.en: President Trump made the decision that it wasn't going to be cost effective.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统决定这样做并不划算。

sentences.en: It wasn't going to be smart to just build an addition onto the East Wing, that the entire East Wing needed to be demolished to clear the way for this grand ballroom.
sentences.zh: 仅仅在东翼上加盖并不明智，整个东翼都需要拆除，为这个宏伟的宴会厅扫清障碍。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about that, because what exactly is being bulldozed that people are upset about?
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈这个，因为人们对被推土机夷为平地的东西感到不满，到底是什么？

sentences.en: Like, what are they replacing?
sentences.zh: 他们要取代的是什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So traditionally, the East Wing is the home of the First Lady.
sentences.zh: 传统上，东翼是第一夫人的住所。

sentences.en: That is where the First Lady's offices are.
sentences.zh: 那是第一夫人办公室所在地。

sentences.en: That is where the social office is, the calligrapher.
sentences.zh: 那是社交办公室和书法家工作的地方。

sentences.en: It's known as sort of the softer side of the White House.
sentences.zh: 它被称为白宫比较柔和的一面。

sentences.en: It's where state dinners are planned.
sentences.zh: 国宴是在那里策划的。

sentences.en: It's where parties are planned.
sentences.zh: 派对也是在那里策划的。

sentences.en: It's not as well represented in sort of American lore as, like, the West Wing.
sentences.zh: 它在美国传说中的代表性不如西翼。

sentences.en: You know, there aren't that many famous scenes that have happened in the East Wing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在东翼发生的著名场景并不多。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's no TV show called the East Wing.
sentences.zh: 没有一部电视剧叫《东翼》。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: I mean, I've walked through it, I think, once when I was invited to a White House Christmas party.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我记得有一次受邀参加白宫圣诞派对时走过那里。

sentences.en: But for the people who worked there, you know, the East Wing has been around since about 1900.
sentences.zh: 但对于在那里工作的人来说，东翼自1900年左右就存在了。

sentences.en: It is a part of history.
sentences.zh: 它是历史的一部分。

sentences.en: And the White House does say they have taken steps to take certain things from the East Wing and preserve them ahead of the destruction of the East Wing.
sentences.zh: 白宫确实表示，他们已经采取措施，在拆除东翼之前，将东翼的某些物品保存下来。

sentences.en: You said you had been there.
sentences.zh: 你说你去过那里。

sentences.en: And I'm wondering what kind of condition it was in.
sentences.zh: 我想知道它当时的状态如何。

sentences.en: Like, in other words, is the president right that it could use a renovation?
sentences.zh: 换句话说，总统说它需要翻新，是对的吗？

sentences.en: Well, look, the White House has been renovated over time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你看，白宫随着时间的推移一直在翻新。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, in the 1940s, when Truman renovated the White House, it was in such bad shape that Congress got involved.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，在20世纪40年代，杜鲁门翻新白宫时，它的状况非常糟糕，以至于国会都介入了。

sentences.en: They had to appropriate money.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不拨款。

sentences.en: They had to appoint a commission to oversee the renovations of the White House.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不任命一个委员会来监督白宫的翻新工程。

sentences.en: And so over time, you know, the White House can use upkeep, right, of course.
sentences.zh: 所以随着时间的推移，白宫当然需要维护，对吧？

sentences.en: But it didn't appear to me when I walked through it like it was, like, structurally deficient and needed to be torn down immediately.
sentences.zh: 但我走过的时候，并没有觉得它结构上有缺陷，需要立即拆除。

sentences.en: That's not what I observed anyway.
sentences.zh: 至少我观察到的不是这样。

sentences.en: So you've explained to us that people are upset that this renovation, at least in scope, is a little unusual.
sentences.zh: 所以你已经向我们解释了，人们对这次翻新感到不满，至少在规模上，这有点不同寻常。

sentences.en: Did the president actually break any rules in any of this?
sentences.zh: 总统在这一切过程中真的违反了什么规定吗？

sentences.en: You know, that's a real interesting question, because I think a lot of people have asserted that this is illegal.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个非常有趣的问题，因为我认为很多人都断言这是非法的。

sentences.en: But what makes this interesting, or at least somewhat tricky, is that there is a National Historic Preservation Act of 1966.
sentences.zh: 但让这件事变得有趣，或者至少有点棘手的是，有一项1966年的《国家历史保护法》。

sentences.en: And that requires a strict review process on federal projects that may affect historic buildings.
sentences.zh: 它要求对可能影响历史建筑的联邦项目进行严格的审查程序。

sentences.en: But the White House is actually exempt from that ordinance.
sentences.zh: 但白宫实际上豁免于该条例。

sentences.en: And that's something the White House staff has highlighted.
sentences.zh: 这也是白宫工作人员强调的一点。

sentences.en: And I think what makes things even a little bit more confusing is that although we've seen some drawings and some designs come out,
sentences.zh: 我认为让事情变得更令人困惑的是，尽管我们已经看到了一些图纸和设计方案，

sentences.en: no official plans have ever been submitted to the commission that's supposed to oversee this.
sentences.zh: 但从未向负责监督此事的委员会提交过任何官方计划。

sentences.en: So we haven't seen a final plan yet of what's exactly going to be in store here.
sentences.zh: 所以我们还没有看到最终的计划，不知道这里到底会发生什么。

sentences.en: And Trump has appointed one of his personal lawyers to oversee that commission.
sentences.zh: 特朗普已经任命他的一名私人律师来监督该委员会。

sentences.en: And they've said no such plan is needed for the demolition of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，拆除东翼不需要这样的计划，

sentences.en: wing, but that we will see a plan before they start to actually build.
sentences.zh: 但在他们开始实际建造之前，我们会看到计划。

sentences.en: So it does seem like they're pressing up against the limits of what's legal or what normally would be allowed
sentences.zh: 所以看起来他们确实是在挑战法律的极限，或者是在华盛顿特区拆除或翻新具有重要历史意义的项目时，通常被允许的范围。

sentences.en: when demolishing or renovating a historic project of significance in D.C.
sentences.zh: 但由于法律的起草方式，白宫在这里似乎确实免于正常的规划程序。

sentences.en: But it does seem like the White House is exempt here from the normal planning process because of the way the law is written.
sentences.zh: 你知道，特朗普一直以来的一点就是他行动非常迅速。

sentences.en: You know, and one thing Trump has always done is that he moves very quickly.
sentences.zh: 他在各种政策领域和各种行动中都行动迅速。

sentences.en: And he moves very quickly in all sorts of policy areas and all sorts of actions.
sentences.zh: 这往往让他的批评者、律师、法院或国会手忙脚乱地试图跟上他的步伐。

sentences.en: And oftentimes that leaves his critics or lawyers or the courts or Congress scrambling to try to keep up with him.
sentences.zh: 到那时可能已经太晚了。

sentences.en: And by then it may be too late.
sentences.zh: 建筑现在已经成了瓦砾，对吧？

sentences.en: The building is now rubble, right?
sentences.zh: 当你走到那里时，东翼确实已经成了瓦砾。

sentences.en: When you walk down there, the east wing is literally rubble.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你现在试图申请禁令或去法院阻止这一切，已经太晚了。

sentences.en: And so if you now try to get an injunction or go to court to stop this, it's too late.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 他们能说什么呢？

sentences.en: What are they going to say?
sentences.zh: 把它建成和原来一模一样？

sentences.en: Build it the exact same way it was.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 不过在美学方面，据我所知，他并没有提议要把它建成某种粗野主义建筑，对吧？

sentences.en: In terms of the aesthetics, though, like he's not proposing, as far as I know, that it's going to be some kind of like brutalist architecture, right?
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's promising to at least, from what I can see, adhere to the style, whatever that means, of the rest of the White House.
sentences.zh: 据我所见，他至少承诺会遵循白宫其余部分的风格，无论那意味着什么。

sentences.en: And I just sort of wonder what you make of that and how you interpret that.
sentences.zh: 我只是有点好奇你是怎么看待这件事的，又是如何解读的。

sentences.en: Yeah, they've said they're going to keep the style consistent.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们已经表示会保持风格的一致性。

sentences.en: Now, I do think it's going to be a glamour to the max version of White House style.
sentences.zh: 不过，我确实认为这将是一个极尽奢华版的白宫风格。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, as we're seeing with what he's doing with the Oval Office, we're bringing in all the gold and all the glamour.
sentences.zh: 你知道，正如我们看到他在椭圆形办公室所做的那样，我们正在引入所有的黄金和所有的浮华。

sentences.en: And once this is built and he's promising that it will be built during his administration, you know, future presidents are going to have to live with this.
sentences.zh: 一旦建成，而且他承诺会在其任期内建成，你知道，未来的总统们将不得不与此共存。

sentences.en: Now, could a future president go in and order it to be toned down some and order all the gold to be removed and to be like a more humble ballroom?
sentences.zh: 那么，未来的总统能否进去下令将其调低一些，下令拆除所有的黄金，让它变得像一个更朴素的宴会厅呢？

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But he's certainly leaving his mark on the White House in a way that is as bold as any president in U.S.
sentences.zh: 但他无疑正在以一种与美国历史上任何总统一样大胆的方式在白宫留下自己的印记。

sentences.en: history.
sentences.zh: 历史。

sentences.en: Do you think that the architects and the historians that are upset would be this upset if they liked his aesthetic better?
sentences.zh: 你认为那些感到不满的建筑师和历史学家，如果他们更喜欢他的审美，还会这么不满吗？

sentences.en: Like if Trump wasn't known for being so, as you put it, bold, some might call it garish.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果特朗普不是以你所说的“大胆”——有些人可能会称之为“俗气”——而闻名的话。

sentences.en: Do you think that they would have as big of an issue with him knocking down the East Wing and proposing a ballroom of this size?
sentences.zh: 你认为他们还会对他拆除东翼并提议建造如此规模的宴会厅有那么大的意见吗？

sentences.en: I think that's definitely a factor.
sentences.zh: 我认为这绝对是一个因素。

sentences.en: If you're looking at his designs and think that they're gaudy or showy or over the top or ostentatious, like, yeah, that's going to affect your view of the project.
sentences.zh: 如果你看着他的设计，觉得它们俗气、炫耀、过火或招摇，那么，是的，这会影响你对这个项目的看法。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And you're going to like that.
sentences.zh: 而且你会喜欢那样的。

sentences.en: That's not representative of who we are as Americans.
sentences.zh: 那并不代表我们作为美国人的身份。

sentences.en: We're not in your face showy.
sentences.zh: 我们不是那种咄咄逼人的炫耀。

sentences.en: We're not over the top.
sentences.zh: 我们不会做得太过火。

sentences.en: And so I do think that affects how people view it.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实认为这影响了人们对它的看法。

sentences.en: It looks in some ways like somewhat out of step with sort of a more humble vision of the presidency.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，它看起来与那种更谦逊的总统愿景有些脱节。

sentences.en: But perhaps a more central concern about this project is the money aspect.
sentences.zh: 但关于这个项目，一个更核心的担忧或许是金钱方面的问题。

sentences.en: Where is the money coming from to build this new grand ballroom that the president wants so much?
sentences.zh: 总统如此渴望建造这个新的大宴会厅，钱从哪里来？

sentences.en: Who is paying for it?
sentences.zh: 谁在买单？

sentences.en: And what are the implications of that?
sentences.zh: 这又意味着什么？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是 Wena Liu。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一——《Connections》。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是 Sam Mazursky，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So, Luke, let's talk about the money and the cost of this project.
sentences.zh: 那么，Luke，我们来谈谈这个项目的资金和成本。

sentences.en: What is the price tag?
sentences.zh: 价格标签是多少？

sentences.en: Well, when President Trump first announced the Ballroom Project, he put the price tag at $200 million.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当特朗普总统首次宣布“宴会厅项目”时，他给出的价格是 2 亿美元。

sentences.en: But this week, White House officials said the new price is $300 million.
sentences.zh: 但本周，白宫官员表示新的价格是 3 亿美元。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Significant inflation, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想这是严重的通货膨胀。

sentences.en: But they say they have raised all of the money for this project.
sentences.zh: 但他们说他们已经为这个项目筹集了所有的资金。

sentences.en: They don't need to go to Congress to get an appropriation to ask the taxpayers for any money.
sentences.zh: 他们不需要去国会申请拨款，也不需要向纳税人要钱。

sentences.en: It will all be from donors, people President Trump is calling his friends.
sentences.zh: 这一切都将来自捐赠者，也就是特朗普总统所说的他的朋友们。

sentences.en: Wait, so who are these people?
sentences.zh: 等等，这些人是谁？

sentences.en: Who are the friends, the donors?
sentences.zh: 这些朋友、这些捐赠者是谁？

sentences.en: So, we've been asking the White House about that, and today they put out a list of donors.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们一直在询问白宫，今天他们公布了一份捐赠者名单。

sentences.en: You want to read through some of these names?
sentences.zh: 你想读读其中一些名字吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a mix of powerful, influential, and wealthy people and powerful, influential, and wealthy corporations.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一群由有权势、有影响力、富有的人和有权势、有影响力、富有的公司组成的混合体。

sentences.en: You have the tech companies on there.
sentences.zh: 上面有科技公司。

sentences.en: Almost all the big tech companies are on.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有的大型科技公司都在上面。

sentences.en: You have Amazon, Apple, Google, Microsoft.
sentences.zh: 有亚马逊、苹果、谷歌、微软。

sentences.en: You have the traditional defense contractors like Lockheed Martin.
sentences.zh: 有像洛克希德·马丁这样的传统国防承包商。

sentences.en: You have cryptocurrencies.
sentences.zh: 有加密货币公司。

sentences.en: You've got, you know, Stephen Schwarzman, the CEO of Blackstone.
sentences.zh: 还有，你知道，黑石集团的首席执行官 Stephen Schwarzman。

sentences.en: It is a combination of people who many times want things from the government or at least want to stay on good terms with the government
sentences.zh: 这结合了许多经常需要从政府那里得到东西，或者至少希望与政府保持良好关系的人，

sentences.en: and perhaps also don't want the Trump administration going after them or their businesses.
sentences.zh: 也许也不希望特朗普政府针对他们或他们的企业。

sentences.en: You know, I actually took a look at this list of donors before you and I got on the phone, and some of the companies are recognizable, like some of the ones you mentioned.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在你我通电话之前，我确实看了一眼这份捐赠者名单，其中一些公司是可以辨认出来的，比如你提到的那些。

sentences.en: And it seems obvious why they might want to curry favor with the White House, because at least some of them have business in front of the federal government,
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要讨好白宫似乎显而易见，因为他们中至少有一些人在联邦政府面前有业务往来，

sentences.en: or you can imagine that they will have business in front of the federal government.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以想象他们未来会在联邦政府面前有业务往来。

sentences.en: But there were also a lot of names on here that, frankly, I did not even recognize.
sentences.zh: 但名单上也有很多名字，坦白说，我甚至认不出来。

sentences.en: Like, for example, who are Pepe and Amelia Fanjul, if I'm saying that right?
sentences.zh: 比如，Pepe 和 Amelia Fanjul 是谁，如果我没念错的话？

sentences.en: My understanding is the Fanjuls are historically big Republican donors.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，Fanjul 家族历来是共和党的大金主。

sentences.en: But I don't know.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道。

sentences.en: I haven't spoken to them directly about that donation.
sentences.zh: 我没有直接和他们谈过那笔捐款。

sentences.en: I guess what I'm just getting at is some of these people seem kind of out of left field.
sentences.zh: 我想我只是想说，其中一些人看起来有点出人意料。

sentences.en: And I'm wondering, is that just because I'm unfamiliar with them?
sentences.zh: 我在想，这只是因为我不熟悉他们吗？

sentences.en: Or did it also strike you as a little bit of a hodgepodge?
sentences.zh: 还是说这让你也觉得有点大杂烩的感觉？

sentences.en: So a lot of them were invited to a dinner to raise money for this ballroom.
sentences.zh: 所以他们中的许多人被邀请参加了一场为这个宴会厅筹款的晚宴。

sentences.en: And the person that is in charge of all this fundraising is Meredith O'Rourke, the Trump 2024 campaign's leading donor or leading fundraiser, I should say.
sentences.zh: 负责这一切筹款工作的人是 Meredith O'Rourke，也就是特朗普 2024 年竞选团队的主要捐赠者，或者我应该说是主要的筹款人。

sentences.en: So they brought in their campaign infrastructure to raise money for this project.
sentences.zh: 所以他们动用了他们的竞选基础设施来为这个项目筹款。

sentences.en: And I assume they relied on a lot of the same people they typically hit up for donations in a presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 我假设他们依赖的还是那些在总统竞选中通常会去寻求捐款的人。

sentences.en: Is it typical that a White House renovation would be funded in this way by private donors, companies and individuals, and that on top of that, it was actually solicited?
sentences.zh: 白宫的翻修工程由私人捐赠者、公司和个人以这种方式资助，而且还是主动索要的，这很典型吗？

sentences.en: It's not how things were done traditionally.
sentences.zh: 这并不是传统做法。

sentences.en: If you look back at the last major renovation, which was undertaken by Harry Truman, that was a big gutting of the White House.
sentences.zh: 如果你回顾一下由哈里·杜鲁门主持的最后一次重大翻修，那是一次对白宫的大规模拆除重建。

sentences.en: The White House was in bad shape at that time.
sentences.zh: 当时的白宫状况很糟糕。

sentences.en: They had to do a lot of serious construction.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不进行大量严肃的施工。

sentences.en: But everything was done completely through Congress.
sentences.zh: 但一切都是完全通过国会完成的。

sentences.en: It was funded through a congressional appropriation after a lot of debate on the floor.
sentences.zh: 在国会进行大量辩论后，通过国会拨款进行资助。

sentences.en: The plans were laid out for debate about what should be done and how it should be done.
sentences.zh: 计划被摆出来进行辩论，讨论应该做什么以及如何做。

sentences.en: And so it was a much more, what I would say, public process with more input and a lot of debate before anything was ever built.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个我所说的更公开的过程，在任何东西建成之前，有更多的投入和大量的辩论。

sentences.en: So we knew exactly how much money was going where, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我们确切地知道多少钱花在了哪里，对吧？

sentences.en: In this case, the Trump administration has had Meredith O'Rourke raise money that's going to go to a 501c3 tax-exempt entity called the Trust for the National Mall.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，特朗普政府让 Meredith O'Rourke 筹集的资金将流向一个名为“国家广场信托基金”的 501c3 免税实体。

sentences.en: So the money is going into that trust, and then they're using the money from that trust to do the project.
sentences.zh: 所以钱进入了那个信托基金，然后他们利用那个信托基金的钱来做这个项目。

sentences.en: What that does is it makes it so we can't independently verify how much money everyone gave and who gave, and it does shield the process from some levels of transparency.
sentences.zh: 这样做导致我们无法独立核实每个人捐了多少钱以及谁捐了钱，这确实让这个过程屏蔽了一些透明度。

sentences.en: You know, that said, on the other side, if you don't think taxpayer money should be going
sentences.zh: 你知道，话虽如此，另一方面，如果你认为不应该用纳税人的钱

sentences.en: to build a new ballroom, maybe you're happy that it's being paid for through private donations and that, you know, taxpayer dollars aren't being used here.
sentences.zh: 去建一个新的宴会厅，也许你会很高兴它是通过私人捐款支付的，而且，你知道，这里没有使用纳税人的钱。

sentences.en: Well, okay, but let's talk about this for a second, because just to state something really obvious, I can understand why you might not want an Amazon or a company that might have
sentences.zh: 好吧，没问题，但让我们谈谈这个，因为说点显而易见的事，我可以理解为什么你可能不希望亚马逊或一家公司，

sentences.en: business in front of the government now or in the future to be making donations to what appears to be the president's pet project, right?
sentences.zh: 现在或将来在政府面前有业务往来，去向总统看似私人的项目捐款，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, that is an inherent conflict of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 这是一种内在的利益冲突。

sentences.en: How big of a deal is that?
sentences.zh: 这有多严重？

sentences.en: Is that part of this outcry that we've been talking about?
sentences.zh: 这是我们一直在谈论的强烈抗议的一部分吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think so.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想是这样。

sentences.en: I mean, look, the Trump White House has faced a lot of allegations about the way it has conducted its relationships with businesses and business interests.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看，特朗普白宫面临着许多关于其处理与企业和商业利益关系方式的指控。

sentences.en: You know, he's had this fundraising dinner at the White House for donors to his son's crypto company, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，他在白宫为他儿子的加密货币公司的捐赠者举办了筹款晚宴，对吧？

sentences.en: So if you have questions about coziness or transactions between business interests and the president, that's only going to raise more concerns about these relationships and whether
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你对商业利益与总统之间的亲密关系或交易有疑问，这只会引发对这些关系的更多担忧，以及是否

sentences.en: people are trying to donate money in order to get closer access to the president.
sentences.zh: 人们试图通过捐钱来获得与总统更近的接触机会。

sentences.en: You also mentioned the other side of this argument, though, this idea that maybe it's good that this is not being funded by taxpayers and instead by private donors.
sentences.zh: 你也提到了这个论点的另一面，即这种想法：也许不用纳税人的钱，而是由私人捐赠者资助是件好事。

sentences.en: How strong of an argument is that?
sentences.zh: 这个论点有多强？

sentences.en: You know, according to my email inbox, it's really breaking down along political lines.
sentences.zh: 你知道，根据我的电子邮件收件箱，它确实是沿着政治路线分裂的。

sentences.en: People who are Democrats and don't like President Trump are pretty much outraged about what's going on here.
sentences.zh: 那些是民主党人且不喜欢特朗普总统的人，对这里发生的事情感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: They're outraged by the demolition and they're outraged by this fundraising practice and how it's not going through Congress.
sentences.zh: 他们对拆除工程感到愤怒，对这种筹款方式以及它没有经过国会感到愤怒。

sentences.en: But the Republicans in my inbox say this is great.
sentences.zh: 但我的收件箱里的共和党人说这太棒了。

sentences.en: Like, more presidents should raise money from private corporations to fund things and not rely on the taxpayers all the time.
sentences.zh: 比如，更多的总统应该从私人公司筹集资金来资助项目，而不是一直依赖纳税人。

sentences.en: He's showing hustle.
sentences.zh: 他展现了干劲。

sentences.en: He's showing ambition.
sentences.zh: 他展现了雄心。

sentences.en: He's leveraging business connections for the American people.
sentences.zh: 他正在为美国人民利用商业关系。

sentences.en: So they, you know, it's definitely being interpreted along partisan lines.
sentences.zh: 所以他们，你知道，这绝对是按照党派路线来解读的。

sentences.en: I referred to this earlier as a pet project of Donald Trump's because he has been talking about this ballroom for a little while now, but I wonder if it's actually fair to call
sentences.zh: 我之前把它称为唐纳德·特朗普的私人项目，因为他已经谈论这个宴会厅有一段时间了，但我不知道称其为

sentences.en: it a vanity project.
sentences.zh: 虚荣项目是否公平。

sentences.en: And even if it is and people don't like that, maybe it actually doesn't matter all that much unless you are a historian or a presidential architect or a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 即使它是，而且人们不喜欢这样，也许除非你是历史学家、总统建筑师或民主党人，否则这其实并不重要。

sentences.en: Well, what I do think is true is that every upgrade at the White House at its time was
sentences.zh: 嗯，我确实认为真实的情况是，白宫的每一次升级在当时都被

sentences.en: criticized as wasteful, as unnecessary, and that over time people came to appreciate those parts of the
sentences.zh: 批评为浪费、不必要，而随着时间的推移，人们开始欣赏白宫的那些部分，

sentences.en: White House and, in fact, can't even imagine the building without them anymore.
sentences.zh: 事实上，甚至无法想象没有它们的大楼了。

sentences.en: Like, can you give us an example?
sentences.zh: 比如，你能给我们举个例子吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: Like, if you go through history, look at the different renovations.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你回顾历史，看看不同的翻修工程。

sentences.en: When the East Wing was added, when the Oval Office was added.
sentences.zh: 当东翼被增加时，当椭圆形办公室被增加时。

sentences.en: Now, we haven't seen the ballroom and how it's going to be at the end.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们还没有看到宴会厅以及它最终会是什么样子。

sentences.en: Maybe it will be in 100 years.
sentences.zh: 也许 100 年后会是这样。

sentences.en: People will look back at this and think it's the grandest, best part of the White House.
sentences.zh: 人们会回顾这段历史，认为这是白宫最宏伟、最好的部分。

sentences.en: But also, people could also look at it as a time of excess, of superfluous spending.
sentences.zh: 但人们也可能将其视为一个过度、多余消费的时代。

sentences.en: So we don't really know how history will judge President Trump's transformation of the White
sentences.zh: 所以我们还不知道历史将如何评价特朗普总统对白宫财产的改造。

sentences.en: House property yet.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实知道，有时历史对项目的回顾比当时人们的看法要好。

sentences.en: But we do know that sometimes history looks back on projects more fondly than people did at the current time.
sentences.zh: 你所谈论的基本上是这个项目的遗产将是什么？

sentences.en: What you're talking about is basically what is the legacy of this project going to be?
sentences.zh: 我只是更广泛地好奇，唐纳德·特朗普迄今为止思考其遗产的方式中，是否有线索可以回答这个问题。

sentences.en: And I just sort of wonder more broadly if there are clues that would answer that in how
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这个项目与特朗普总统希望在美国社会留下持久遗产的愿望完全交织在一起。

sentences.en: Donald Trump has seemed to think about his legacy so far.
sentences.zh: 他希望被铭记为历史上伟大的总统之一。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think this project is completely intertwined with President Trump's desire to leave a lasting legacy on American society.
sentences.zh: 他有时会谈论，他的员工有时也会谈论他被加入拉什莫尔山。

sentences.en: He wants to be remembered as one of the great presidents in history.
sentences.zh: 他公开渴望获得诺贝尔和平奖和白宫的大规模翻修。

sentences.en: He sometimes talks, and his staff sometimes talk about him being added to Mount Rushmore.
sentences.zh: 无论它在当下是否引起愤怒，那都将是唐纳德·特朗普在美国社会留下的持久印记。

sentences.en: He has openly coveted a Nobel Peace Prize and a huge renovation at the White House.
sentences.zh: 如果一个世纪后，人们在参观白宫时说，这就是唐纳德·特朗普总统在 2025 年建造的大宴会厅，

sentences.en: Whether or not it creates outrage in the current day, that will be a lasting signature of Donald
sentences.zh: 你知道，这让他对美国历史的掌控比现在更深。

sentences.en: Trump's on American society.
sentences.zh: 这可能就是为什么这触动了人们如此敏感的神经，对吧？

sentences.en: If in a century from now, people are going on tours of the White House and they're saying, and here is the grand ballroom that was built by President Donald J.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你讨厌唐纳德·特朗普，认为他是最糟糕的，那么你就会对这个想法感到冒犯：

sentences.en: Trump in 2025,
sentences.zh: 他可能会进行这种巨大的翻修工程，将白宫的一部分变成看起来像海湖庄园的样子，

sentences.en: you know, that gives him even more of a hold on American history than he does currently.
sentences.zh: 这对他的许多批评者来说，是他过度、俗气和浪费的象征。

sentences.en: And that's probably why this has struck such a nerve with people, right?
sentences.zh: 但如果你爱特朗普总统，那么你看着这个就会想，他确实值得拥有一个 9 万平方英尺的宴会厅。

sentences.en: Like, if you hate Donald Trump and you think he is the worst, then you are offended at the idea
sentences.zh: 这正是他应该进行的那种项目。

sentences.en: that he might undergo this enormous renovation project that would turn part of the White House
sentences.zh: 所以感觉每个人对这次总统任期的感受，现在都投射到了这个拆除和建设项目上。

sentences.en: into what looks like Mar-a-Lago, which is the symbol to many of his critics of his excess and gaudiness and waste.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉每个人对这次总统任期的感受，现在都投射到了这个拆除和建设项目上。

sentences.en: But if you love President Trump, then you are looking at this and thinking, he does deserve a 90,000-square-foot ballroom.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉每个人对这次总统任期的感受，现在都投射到了这个拆除和建设项目上。

sentences.en: And this is exactly the type of project he should undergo.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉每个人对这次总统任期的感受，现在都投射到了这个拆除和建设项目上。

sentences.en: So it feels like everybody's feelings about this presidency are projected onto this demolition and construction project right now.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉每个人对这次总统任期的感受，现在都投射到了这个拆除和建设项目上。

sentences.en: You know, they say in politics that the anecdote or the image that sticks with people is the one that reinforces what they already thought about the politician.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们常说在政治中，能让人印象深刻的轶事或形象，往往是那些强化了他们对某位政治人物既有看法的内容。

sentences.en: And in this case, the symbol of literally the East Wing being torn down, like rubble, demolition, debris, is to many Americans on the
sentences.zh: 而在这种情况下，东翼被拆除的象征意义——就像瓦砾、废墟、残骸一样——对许多美国

sentences.en: left, the perfect metaphor for the Trump presidency.
sentences.zh: 左派人士来说，是特朗普总统任期的完美隐喻。

sentences.en: They are watching him literally tear down history, tear down the government, and tear down an important piece of America.
sentences.zh: 他们眼睁睁看着他亲手拆毁历史，拆毁政府，拆毁美国的一处重要地标。

sentences.en: And that's what they think he's doing to the country.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们认为他正在对这个国家做的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, on the other hand, if you are one of Trump's supporters, and you kind of think America hasn't
sentences.zh: 另一方面，如果你是特朗普的支持者，你觉得美国一直以来

sentences.en: been working for you, and you elected Trump to tear down some of the status quo and rebuild
sentences.zh: 没能为你服务，你选特朗普是为了打破现状并重建

sentences.en: this new America that's more to your liking and more in the mold of President Trump, then you don't have a problem with this.
sentences.zh: 一个更合你心意、更符合特朗普总统风格的新美国，那你对这件事就不会有什么意见。

sentences.en: It also just all makes me think of this other question that people have about this administration,
sentences.zh: 这也让我想到人们对本届政府的另一个疑问，

sentences.en: which is how much of what is happening is permanent and will endure after Donald Trump, and how much of it could change with a new Congress or a new president.
sentences.zh: 那就是正在发生的事情中有多少是永久性的，会在唐纳德·特朗普卸任后持续存在，又有多少会随着新一届国会或新总统的更迭而改变。

sentences.en: And smashing the East Wing of the White House certainly sends one very specific answer to that question.
sentences.zh: 而将白宫东翼夷为平地，无疑为这个问题给出了一个非常明确的答案。

sentences.en: You know, Rachel, I think—actually, I hadn't thought about it that way, and I think you hit the nail on the head there.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋，我想——说实话，我之前没从这个角度想过，我觉得你一针见血地指出了重点。

sentences.en: It's the permanency of it, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是它的永久性，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, if you're a liberal American, you're thinking you can grit your teeth through the Trump years, you can win the next election, and things can go back to normal.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你是一个自由派美国人，你会想你可以咬牙熬过特朗普执政的几年，赢得下一次选举，一切就能恢复正常。

sentences.en: But if the East Wing's a bunch of rubble,
sentences.zh: 但如果东翼变成了一堆瓦砾，

sentences.en: and there's the Trump ballroom standing in its place, that's a permanent reminder
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是特朗普宴会厅，那将是一个永久的提醒，

sentences.en: of what it was like in Trump's America, and that's going to stay on the test of time and can't be erased.
sentences.zh: 提醒人们特朗普时代的美国是什么样子，这将经受住时间的考验，无法被抹去。

sentences.zh: 卢克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
